answers.core: This edit is to the 3D node Physical Bone in Godot's C++ code. An asset library could work but we would be reimplementing all the physical bone functionality in Godot already. I imagine this works and will try it but I think for such a small change and such a large quality of life improvement it should be incorporated into Godot's codebase.
answers.workaround: There is no workaround as the current Physical Bone does not work unless its parent is a skeleton which requires it to be a child of the skeleton node. The only workaround I see is building a GDNative addon that implements a new node called the GlobalPhysicalBone which has all the same Physical Bone code + this feature.

title: Expose PhysicalBone's skeleton parameter to allow physical bones outside the tree of the skeleton node
